name: 97212 · Portland, OR
findings: ZIP 97212 (Portland) has 177 nonprofit organizations. 92 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 83 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97212 (Portland) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 97212 (Portland) list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).
